shipped.title: michaelmonetized/omatainer · #510 app software checklist — 27 features in a day
shipped.summary: The stage app went from deck tool toward full DAW overnight. Every feature commit was followed by a qualified, installed build recorded against the live stage session, with Pioneer, APC40 mkII and MPD hardware checked by hand. #510 is still open (437 files).
bullets: Session view: shared audio clips, atomic clip management with native presets, launch modes with musical timing and legato, scene launch properties
Arrangement view: linear playback on a native timeline, song sections with quantized loop navigation, sample-timed MIDI clock out
Mixing: isolated headphone cue bus with saved routing, mic and auxiliary mixer, saved track input monitoring, audio export and recoverable performance recording
Decks: beat jump, unified Cue audition, per-deck quantization, named loop banks, performance pad modes, tempo/beat/bar sync, hot cues linked to loops, pitch pickup and momentary bend
Hardware: APC40 mkII grid rows corrected from a physical controller capture; configurable encoder formats and high-res MIDI controls; indexed large-library browsing

shipped.title: michaelmonetized/editbay · 9 more R2/R3 PRs + 9 issues
shipped.summary: The native editor kept hardening sound and delivery: sustained-playback callback timing, a bounded and measured sound backend, reusable sound kernels, canonical PCM across cold seeks, source sound prepared ahead of playback, exact frame-range export in native and CLI, durable recovery checkpoints, and PipeWire presentation accounting. Nothing merged yet.
bullets: #44 Measure coherent callback time through bounded sustained playback
#46 Render bounded procedural masks and complete compact native cuts
#50 R3: export exact composition frame ranges in native and CLI workflows
#54 Preserve canonical PCM across cold seeks and decoder eviction
#58 Publish durable recovery checkpoints without blocking native input
#60 Account native PipeWire presentation and reject dropped device writes
